t: You're looking at the Duke of York's Theatre on St Martin's Lane, in the City of Westminster. It's a West End playhouse, now named the Tom Stoppard Theatre. It was designed by Walter Emden, one of the leading English theatre and music hall architects during the building boom between 1885 and 1915. That boom produced a great many of the theatres Londoners still queue outside today, and Emden was among the busiest hands behind it.
